fact: The party decided their first stop would be the cavern of the stone giants.
source_quote: The party decided their first stop would be the cavern of the stone giants.
subject: first destination chosen

fact: Hgraam is contending with another of his brothers who has succumbed to the two-headed curse.
source_quote: They found Hgraam already contending with another of his brothers who had succumbed to the two-headed curse
subject: Hgraam

fact: Hgraam's brother's massive form is twisted and confused due to the curse.

subject: two-headed giant brother

subject: statue presented

fact: Thorin explains to Hgraam that the Derro had been using dark rituals to drive the giants into a rampage.
source_quote: He explained that the Derro had been using dark rituals to drive the giants into a rampage.
subject: Derro accusation

fact: Hgraam probes whether the ritual was the work of the derro ruling council.
source_quote: Hgraam probed whether the ritual was the work of the derro ruling council.

fact: The party uses the "we don't know who they were" defense regarding the derro council.

fact: Thorin rolls a 13 on persuasion with advantage as a giant-friend.
source_quote: Thorin's persuasion roll (13, with advantage as a giant-friend) held.

fact: Hgraam declares that with the statue he can begin to cure his afflicted kin.

fact: Hgraam presses five hundred gold pieces into the party's hands as a reward.
source_quote: He pressed five hundred gold pieces into the party's hands as a reward.
subject: gold reward

fact: Hgraam warns the party that the Stone Guard is growing increasingly agitated.
source_quote: He warned them, however, that the Stone Guard was growing increasingly agitated.

source_quote: the stone guard have become more agitated recently. I suggest you be careful around them.

subject: Hgraam

source_quote: though "little people" have told him it does.
